title: Sampling at intermediate temperatures is optimal for training large language models in protein structure prediction
abstract: arXiv:2603.29529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Using a statistical mechanics framework, we investigate the parameter space of transformer models trained on protein sequence data. We sample the loss landscape at varying temperatures using Langevin dynamics to characterize the low-loss manifold, and to understand the mechanisms underlying transformers' superior performance in protein structure prediction. We find that, at variance with networks not based on the attention mechanism, the lack of a first--order--like transition in the loss of the transformer produces a range of intermediate temperatures with good learning properties; this is true both for synthetic and natural protein sequences. We also show that the parameters of most layers are highly conserved at these temperatures if the dimension of the embedding is optimal, and we provide an operative way to find this dimension. translated_title: 在中等温度下采样是训练用于蛋白质结构预测的大型语言模型的最优策略
translated_abstract: 利用统计力学框架，我们研究了在蛋白质序列数据上训练的transformer模型的参数空间。我们通过朗之万动力学在不同温度下对损失景观进行采样，以刻画低损失流形，并理解transformer在蛋白质结构预测中表现卓越的内在机制。我们发现，与不基于注意力机制的网络不同，transformer的损失函数中不存在一级类相变，这使得存在一系列具有良好学习性质的中等温度；这一结论对合成蛋白质序列和天然蛋白质序列均成立。我们还证明，当嵌入维度最优时，大多数层的参数在这些温度下高度保守，并且我们提供了一种寻找该最优维度的可操作方法。此外，我们表明注意力矩阵对蛋白质接触图的预测能力更强……
tldr: 本研究借助统计力学方法发现，transformer模型因损失函数中缺乏一阶类相变而在中等温度下采样训练具有最优学习性能，同时给出了确定最优嵌入维度的实用方法，为蛋白质结构预测中大语言模型的训练提供了理论指导和操作方案。
en_tdlr: Using a statistical mechanics framework, this study reveals that transformers lack a first-order-like loss transition, making intermediate-temperature sampling optimal for training protein structure prediction models, and provides a practical method to determine the optimal embedding dimension.
